tasks.title: Causal Playground
tasks.outcome: A pilot deliberately intervenes in a working Ceres freight encounter and can understand the physical and social consequences.
tasks.acceptance: The existing B12 owner meets its unchanged five-seed gate; a separate ordinary-route demonstration supports at least two deliberately different outcomes. Receipt coverage alone is not causality or fun.
tasks.writeBoundary: One Ceres pocket/encounter and its focused fixtures. Shared encounter, traffic and physics owners only through exact, freshly checked hunks.
grunt: Attach stable actor-life and originating-incident references at the one missing producer/consumer seam found by the trace.
Repair one camera-scale threat/opportunity cue through existing presentation owners.
Add a negative case in which an unrelated collision cannot count as the player-created disaster.

tasks.title: Battlefield Intelligence
tasks.outcome: At fighting speed the player can distinguish an enemy, neutral worker and ally, read an imminent threat, and identify a legitimate intervention.
tasks.acceptance: Selection, relation, intent, action eligibility and the actual command agree in focused tests; a visual review at the ordinary camera confirms readable priority and shape-based identity.
tasks.writeBoundary: Existing descriptor/target projection plus a minimal ORRERY presentation consumer. Coordinate shared targeting and telegraph hunks with PR605.
grunt: Add one missing intent-to-existing-glyph mapping with a non-color discriminator.
Connect one existing owner denial to its interaction readout.
Add a stale-target, capture or relation-change regression to the exact descriptor seam.

tasks.title: Tactical Command
tasks.outcome: The pilot controls a small useful wing while still flying: holding a position, screening a specific asset, concentrating attack, and regrouping are distinct tactical decisions.
tasks.acceptance: The same encounter supports screening a hauler, holding a choke and a focused attack with measurably different positions, protected damage and exposure. Orders are acknowledged, cancellable and durable only where intended.
tasks.writeBoundary: Existing wing-order data, radial intent and recipient behavior. Do not rewrite automation, input binding or AI authority; take exact hunks only.
grunt: Add a truthful order acknowledgment and one actionable blocked reason.
Cover an invalid or captured attack target with regroup/fallback behavior.
Measure a guard’s leash and intercept on the real movement port.

tasks.title: Adversarial Tactics
tasks.outcome: Enemies execute recognizable plans with exploitable commitments instead of orbiting as interchangeable damage sources.
tasks.acceptance: A raiding squad can commit to cargo interception, cover its withdrawal and abandon an unfavorable fight. Different player interventions change the plan through observed information, not hidden knowledge.
tasks.writeBoundary: One existing squad doctrine and its perception/action adapter; exact paths coordinated with combat convergence.
grunt: Add a lost-contact case that uses last-known information and then expires it.
Give one tactic a visible windup/commit/recovery cue.
Repair one target-switch oscillation with existing hysteresis rather than hard immunity.

tasks.title: Signal Warfare
tasks.outcome: Scouting and deception change what the player and opponents can reasonably know, making preparation and concealment useful.
tasks.acceptance: An observed patrol/weakness changes a tactical opportunity; a decoy or bounded interference can mislead an eligible observer and can be countered. Hidden facts remain hidden.
tasks.writeBoundary: One existing information producer and perception consumer, plus minimal known-world presentation. No new global sensor truth.
grunt: Display age/confidence for one existing stale contact without inventing exact coordinates.
Add a legitimate reacquisition counter to one deception effect.
Test cloak break/reveal on attack, collision or scanning using actual owners.

tasks.title: Physical Infrastructure
tasks.outcome: A working industrial place becomes cover, leverage, hazard and objective; changing a physical component changes what the place can do.
tasks.acceptance: At one site, a handling mechanism, a sensing/control component and a bounded hazardous component produce distinct causal interventions. Sabotage, defense and rescue are possible without scripted imitation.
tasks.writeBoundary: One existing industrial site, its authored data and narrow operation hooks. Physics writes remain behind physicsAuthority.
grunt: Wire one existing damage state to actual machine throughput or availability.
Repair a collision proxy or approach clearance for the chosen interaction.
Add a destruction/recovery/Continue test for one component and finite workpiece.

tasks.title: Combinatorial Combat
tasks.outcome: The player learns a small vocabulary of reliable powers and combines it into ridiculous but intelligible physical results.
tasks.acceptance: Three compositions work through real owner paths: collect-and-release mass, a linked shielding corridor, and displaced enemies entering useful machinery. Each has a cost, tell, vulnerability and recovery behavior.
tasks.writeBoundary: Continue/reconcile the existing Controlled Chaos owner after its relevant hunks land; never independently recreate pylons, collection or target authority.
grunt: Add a denied-placement preview using the actual pylon owner’s geometry/cost query.
Connect a real aggregate-release result to mass/material-scaled feedback.
Add actor-generation and relation-change regressions for one propagated attack.

tasks.title: Pursuit and Escape
tasks.outcome: Illegal or accidental interventions produce understandable searches and escapes, not an arbitrary punishment meter.
tasks.acceptance: The player can explain who observed what, why a response escalated, and what legitimate action ends or changes the pursuit. Finite consequences survive return/Continue correctly.
tasks.writeBoundary: One witnessed incident → existing response → existing escape/settlement path. Keep heat, law, custody and economy authority separate.
grunt: Add a causal explanation for one genuine dispatch from its incident receipt.
Test an unwitnessed assault cannot acquire a fabricated conviction.
Repair one escape/impound route that continues to reference a dead or captured hull.

tasks.title: Supply-Line Warfare
tasks.outcome: Controlling a local physical shipment changes useful strategic options: stock, service availability or reinforcement capacity.
tasks.acceptance: A delivered, delayed, stolen and destroyed version of the same finite lot yield correctly different downstream outcomes with source-linked explanations and conserved value.
tasks.writeBoundary: One existing contested route and one finite commodity/service chain. No second stock or faction-ownership writer.
grunt: Add one origin-lot/destination-settlement identity to an existing shipment receipt.
Explain one real shortage through the current market read model.
Add duplicate, partial-delivery and stolen-then-recovered accounting cases.

tasks.title: Personal Consequences
tasks.outcome: A recognizable person reacts later to a real encounter with the player, changing an opportunity or behavior without inventing history.
tasks.acceptance: A verified rescue, betrayal or humiliation changes a later decision/opportunity; death, lack of evidence and save/load cannot create false memories or replay payment.
tasks.writeBoundary: One existing named/remembered captain and one readout or encounter consumer. Reuse current identity and memory owners.
parents: existing captain / ace / moral memory seam
grunt: Connect one existing memory field to an available service or behavior.
Repair one stale captain reference across pod ejection and capture.
Add a negative case for an unknown/unwitnessed action and one terminal-save case.

tasks.title: Multi-Party Operations
tasks.outcome: Three replayable operations behave like situations with competing goals, not corridors with a single required trick.
tasks.acceptance: Convoy interception, contested salvage and an industrial defense each support three materially different strategies, an honest exit, partial success and physical aftermath.
tasks.writeBoundary: One operation at a time under existing mission/encounter owners. New authored data modules are preferable to broad monolith edits.
grunt: Author one actor’s legible goal/tell and its noncombat outcome.
Add a partial-success settlement to one existing mission family.
Cover a player who leaves halfway, returns later or resolves the situation in an unexpected order.

tasks.title: Scenario Forge and Agent Workflow
tasks.outcome: Agents can extend one validated situation, inspect what really happened and produce a reviewable implementation without rebuilding the engine or inventing evidence.
tasks.acceptance: The same existing lab can exercise three operation variations with stable identities, raw-input control, explicit setup exceptions and real-owner assertions. Existing certification boundaries remain intact.
tasks.writeBoundary: Existing generic simScenario lab, scenario data and narrow authoring utilities. Narrative scenarioSchemas remains Campaign 47-A-specific.
grunt: Turn one manual reproduction into a raw-input tape using current accepted fields.
Add a metric that reads an existing authoritative outcome without writing to it.
Shrink one agent context packet to the actual owner files, current source SHA and observed failure.

tasks.title: Cinematic Causal Feedback
tasks.outcome: Anticipation, action, impact and aftermath communicate what happened and how much it mattered, while the player retains control and tactical visibility.
tasks.acceptance: One light-body throw, one heavy collision and one field interaction have distinctive readable responses based on real mass/material/outcome; incoming threats remain identifiable and existing performance/accessibility contracts are met.
tasks.writeBoundary: One complete interaction’s existing presentation/audio consumers; respect NOCTURNE, current Look and ORRERY ownership.
grunt: Replace one generic impact with owner-driven material/mass differentiation.
Add a cancellation/rejection response for an action that currently appears to do nothing.
Give one overload/reduced-motion case a lower-cost presentation path without changing gameplay.
